name: Shihen II ~Saitan no Catastrophe~
original_name: 詩篇II～再誕のカタストロフ～
source:
20 years have passed.... The country is governed by Felix and every citizen lives a peaceful life. One day, Jan receives a job offer that is to steal a holy sword. Jan soon accepts the offer lured by extraordinary reward. But this is just the beginning of massive disturbance.... As Jan is involved in the wave of fate, he meets five girls, which causes another great social change.... What will happen when it ends...? Shihen 69.... A forbidden power is now released again....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090924020412/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012501]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
20年过去了…国家如今由菲利克斯统治，所有国民都过着和平的生活。一天，扬接到一份偷取圣剑的委托。异常丰厚的报酬令他动心，很快便接受了任务。然而，这仅仅是一场巨大动乱的开端…当扬被卷入命运的浪潮时，他遇见了五名少女，又一次重大的社会变革也由此发生…一切结束时，究竟会变成什么样？《诗篇69》…被禁忌的力量如今将再度释放…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090924020412/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012501]ErogeShop[/url]]
